339cc567: What is Goku's real Saiyan name?
Goku's real name is Kakarot — the Saiyan name given by his parents Bardock and Gine. He was sent to Earth as a baby just before Planet Vegeta was destroyed.
dc1b8262: What is the name of the Saiyans' home planet?
Planet Vegeta is the Saiyans' home world — destroyed by Frieza, who feared the growing power of this warrior race.
6c6fc194: Bardock is the father of Goku and Raditz — a low-class Saiyan warrior who foresees the destruction of his planet before dying while fighting Frieza.
b109b0b7: What transformation does Goku reach against Frieza on Namek?
Goku becomes a Super Saiyan during his duel with Frieza — triggered by Krillin's death, his rage makes his ki explode and his hair turn gold.
c13c4b24: What is the name of Goku's signature technique?
The Kamehameha is the series' iconic technique — invented by Master Roshi after 50 years of effort, Goku masters it after watching it once.
2437f3e8: How many balls make up a set of Dragon Balls?
A set has 7 Dragon Balls, with one to seven stars. Gathering them summons Shenron, who grants a wish (three for the Namekian Dragon Balls).
c04b81bd: What is the name of the dragon summoned by Earth's Dragon Balls?
Shenron is summoned by Earth's 7 Dragon Balls — he grants one wish per summoning. Porunga is his Namekian equivalent, who grants three.
63b91b96: Which ultimate transformation does Goku reach in Dragon Ball Super?
Ultra Instinct lets Goku dodge and counter automatically without thinking — surpassing even the Gods of Destruction.
434a43d4: What is the name of Universe 7's God of Destruction?
Beerus is Universe 7's God of Destruction — he seeks the Super Saiyan God in Dragon Ball Super after a prophecy.
c1dbcec2: What is the name of Beerus's angel attendant?
Whis is Beerus's angel attendant — more powerful than the God of Destruction himself, he can rewind time by 3 minutes.
348c405d: What is Vegeta's ultimate technique in the Cell saga?
Final Flash is Vegeta's ultimate Super Saiyan attack against Cell — he pours all his energy into one blast that nearly kills Perfect Cell.
a4627804: What is the tournament between 8 universes in Dragon Ball Super called?
The Tournament of Power pits the 8 weakest universes against each other — the losers' universes are erased by Zeno.
a06714b8: Which Universe 11 fighter pushes Goku to reach Ultra Instinct?
Jiren is a member of Universe 11's Pride Troopers — so powerful that he surpasses the Gods of Destruction and pushes Goku toward Ultra Instinct.
d0a11153: What is the Potara earring fusion of Goku and Vegeta called?
Vegito is the Potara fusion — permanent in theory, but in Super it comes apart inside the body of Fused Zamasu.
9af6e160: What is the Fusion Dance fusion of Goku and Vegeta called?
Gogeta is the Fusion Dance fusion — temporary (about 30 minutes). He faces Broly with extreme power in Dragon Ball Super: Broly.
19cb7620: What is the name of the Omni-King who can erase universes?
Zeno (Zen-Oh) is the Omni-King, ruler of all universes — naive and childlike in appearance, he can instantly erase anything from existence.
877774fd: In which Dragon Ball film does Goku face Beerus for the first time?
Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods (2013) introduces Beerus the God of Destruction — marking the start of the Super era and of gods in the Dragon Ball universe.
e6fb25fc: What is Vegeta's sacrificial technique against Majin Buu?
Final Explosion is Vegeta's sacrificial technique — he channels all his life energy into a massive explosion to kill Buu, at the cost of his own life (temporarily).
144022e7: How does Gohan reach his full potential in the Buu saga?
Training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber
The Elder Kai unlocks Gohan's Potential Unleashed (Ultimate Gohan) through a long ritual — Gohan reaches his maximum power without a Super Saiyan transformation, surpassing Super Saiyan 3 Goku.
01154b11: Bulma is Trunks's mother — heir of Capsule Corporation, she has been one of the most important characters since the very first Dragon Ball.
1b18add2: Which Universe 6 fighter can manipulate time in combat?
Hit is Universe 6's legendary assassin — his Time Skip technique lets him freeze time for a fraction of a second to land invisible blows.
9f1df8e1: Who absorbs Android 17 and 18 to reach his perfect form?
Cell is designed to absorb Androids 17 and 18 with his tail — absorbing 17 gives him his semi-perfect form, then 18 his ultimate perfect form.
ba5d5176: What wish does Android 17 make after winning the Tournament of Power?
To restore all the erased universes
Android 17, the surprise winner of the tournament, asks for all the erased universes to be restored — a selfless act that reveals his generous nature.
7cd51d6f: What is the link between Tarble and Vegeta?
Tarble is Vegeta's younger brother — exiled by their father for being too weak. He appears in the special “Yo! Son Goku and His Friends Return!!” (2008).
535d1b64: What is the room where a year passes for every day outside called?
The Hyperbolic Time Chamber (Room of Spirit and Time) is a special dimension at Kami's Lookout — 1 day outside equals 1 year inside, allowing accelerated, intensive training.
a4106209: What is Vegeta's rank among the Saiyans?
Vegeta is the Prince of all Saiyans — the highest rank below the king. His royal pride is at the heart of his obsessive rivalry with Goku, a mere low-class Saiyan.
ffe197e4: Who is the youngest Super Saiyan in the whole timeline?
Goten is the youngest Super Saiyan — he reaches the transformation naturally while training with his mother Chi-Chi, far younger than Gohan was.
e11ad8b0: Which character says the famous line “It's over 9000!”?
Vegeta says this line when reading Goku's power level with his scouter — in the original Japanese the number is 8,000, but “It's over 9000!” in the English dub became a worldwide meme.
e03572ec: Who is the first enemy that Goku and Piccolo fight together?
Raditz is the first major enemy — Goku and Piccolo team up to defeat him. Piccolo pierces them both with his Special Beam Cannon, killing Raditz and also Goku (temporarily).
541495cb: Which Dragon Ball Super saga introduces Zamasu and Goku Black?
Dragon Ball Super's Future Trunks saga introduces Goku Black — a Kai apprentice from Universe 10 (Zamasu) who took Goku's body to exterminate humanity in the name of divine justice.
11e89e7c: Which 2022 Dragon Ball Super film pits Gohan and Piccolo against new Androids?
Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero (2022) sees Gohan and Piccolo face Androids Gamma 1 and Gamma 2 — Piccolo becomes Orange Piccolo and Gohan reaches his new Beast form.
e118c4cd: Kami created Earth's 7 Dragon Balls with his own divine energy — which is why they vanish when Kami dies or fuses with Piccolo.
4b5b161e: What is the final wish made in the Buu saga so that humans forget?
The wish erases all memory of Buu from every human — letting the reformed Mr. Buu live peacefully among humans without being hunted.
f799b8e0: How does Frieza reach his Golden form?
Through an injection from Dr. Gero
Frieza reaches his Golden form after only 4 months of training — he had never needed to train given his innate power, but realizes it had been holding him back.
f8692d5e: Who is Goku's eternal rival throughout the series?
Vegeta is Goku's eternal rival and partner — the Saiyan prince who starts as a villain before becoming a hero. Their rivalry is one of the most iconic in manga.
9d3f2237: What is the Potara fusion of Caulifla and Kale called?
Kefla is the Potara fusion of Universe 6's Caulifla and Kale — her colossal power pushes Goku to use Ultra Instinct -Sign- to defeat her.
01a302ae: What is the name of Gohan and Videl's daughter?
Pan is Gohan and Videl's daughter — Goku's granddaughter. She plays a major role in Dragon Ball GT and DBS: Super Hero.
6ac0f7c5: Which symbol does Goku wear on his gi while training with Master Roshi?
The kanji “Kame” (turtle) stands for Master Roshi's Turtle School, where Goku and Krillin train.
787a0ade: Who judges the souls of the dead in the Other World?
King Yemma judges the souls of the dead and decides where they go. He lets Goku take Snake Way after his death against Raditz.
92b3ead6: Who is the first human to fight Goku in the original Dragon Ball?
Yamcha is the first human to fight Goku, in the desert — a bandit at first, he becomes a friend and ally of the Z Fighters. He is known as the desert bandit.
cf39b622: How does Goku learn Instant Transmission?
Learned on planet Yardrat after Namek
Goku learns Instant Transmission (Shunkan Idō) on planet Yardrat after the Namek arc — the Yardratians teach him the technique on his way back to Earth.
9342f2cf: What is the name of Goku and Chi-Chi's second son?
Goten is born after the Cell saga and appears in the Buu saga. He looks exactly like his father as a child.
290d8116: Which of Vegeta's attacks consists of firing a huge energy ball with one hand?
The Big Bang Attack is Vegeta's Super Saiyan signature — a huge blue energy ball fired from an open hand. It differs from Final Flash, which is charged with both hands.
e53ca27f: Who is the Namekians' Grand Elder, who can unlock warriors' hidden potential?
Guru (the Grand Elder) is the Namekians' elder and the creator of Namek's Dragon Balls — he unlocks the full potential of Gohan and Krillin during their visit.
9693ca14: How many members does Universe 7's team have in the Tournament of Power?
Universe 7's team has 10 members — Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Piccolo, Android 17, Android 18, Krillin, Tien, Master Roshi and Frieza (replacing Buu). Each universe fields 10 fighters.
30cda0e1: What is the Spirit Bomb Goku uses against Kid Buu called?
The Super Spirit Bomb against Kid Buu is powered by the energy of Earth's entire revived population — Goku asks them to lend him their energy, a memorable scene of the Buu saga.
b88ae787: Who rules the Saiyans' planet before it is destroyed?
King Vegeta, father of Prince Vegeta, rules the Saiyans until Frieza kills him and destroys their planet.
84071371: Which technique gathers energy from all living beings?
The Spirit Bomb (Genki Dama) is a King Kai technique — it gathers the life energy of all willing beings. The concentration it requires leaves Goku vulnerable while charging.
4a8260aa: Which Namekian dragon can grant 3 wishes?
Porunga is the dragon of Namek's Dragon Balls — he can grant 3 wishes per summoning, unlike Earth's Shenron (1 wish). He is bigger and more powerful than Shenron.
38efa30e: How can Piccolo regenerate lost limbs?
Namekians can regenerate their limbs thanks to their biology — Piccolo uses this against Frieza to regrow a lost arm and surprise his enemy.
c92a7041: What is Babidi's plan to revive Majin Buu?
Absorb fighters' energy during a tournament
Babidi sends his henchmen to the World Martial Arts Tournament to absorb the fighters' ki — each fight generates energy that feeds Buu's ball until he is reborn.
ef63f29d: Who is the mother of Bulla, Vegeta's daughter?
Bulla (Bra) is the daughter of Vegeta and Bulma. She is born after Buu's defeat.
95688e6b: How does Gohan beat Cell at the Cell Games?
He does not beat him alone

Super Saiyan 2 Gohan, with spirit Goku at his side, overpowers Cell's Super Kamehameha with a father-son Kamehameha — Goku encourages Gohan from the afterlife, one of the most moving moments of the saga.
b03c3234: What is Vegeta's first transformation during his fight against Goku on Earth?
Vegeta creates an artificial moon himself to turn into a Great Ape (Oozaru). Yajirobe eventually cuts off his tail.
13a0959c: Who is Bardock and what happens to him in Dragon Ball Z's flashbacks?
Goku's biological father, who dies fighting Frieza
An elite warrior who survives Planet Vegeta's destruction
Bardock is Goku's (Kakarot's) biological father — a low-class Saiyan warrior who foresees Frieza destroying his planet. He dies trying to face Frieza alone.
7eedec88: What is the bond between Gohan and Piccolo beyond fighting?
Piccolo is his mentor and a substitute father figure
Piccolo is Gohan's father figure — he trains him during the year before the Saiyans arrive, building a deep bond. This friendship lasts the whole series and peaks in DBS: Super Hero.
1d15d53a: Which human in Dragon Ball Z has a third eye and masters highly concentrated ki techniques?
Tien Shinhan, a former student of the Crane School, masters formidable techniques such as the Tri-Beam (Kikoho).
90c0fcbf: What is the main difference between Kaioken and Super Saiyan?
Kaioken multiplies power but wrecks the body — Super Saiyan is a stable transformation
Kaioken is a temporary multiplier technique that quickly damages the body — beyond x4, the risks become extreme. Super Saiyan is a stable transformation that boosts power without immediate damage.
